en: A colorized vintage panoramic view of a spa town surrounded by forested hills. In the foreground stands a large octagonal white building with red decorative bands and many arched windows, next to other grand spa or hotel buildings and a tall red chimney. Behind it stretches a dense cluster of ornate 19th‑century houses, hotels, and pavilions embedded in greenery. The single printed caption in the sky area at upper left reads "Marienbad." The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century European postcard.
